conviction_note: Small findings in both directions. Operating profit should rise several times over against a weak Q3 2025 base (op income RMB28.3m), and management said in August it expected 'meaningful breakthroughs at the operating profit level' in H2. Against that: revenue is at risk versus a bar that is already cut, because online marketing laps +51.1% and devices lap a 50%-margin pen launch. This name has also closed lower on the print day in three of its last four releases (-8.1, -4.5, -6.9, +1.3), even on EPS beats. The sum of the findings (-1.0) and the scaled number (-0.65 = (2*0.45-1)*6.5) agree in sign. p_up is only 45 because the bar is thin and the profit upside is real.
bar: Revenue roughly RMB1.67-1.70bn for Q3 2026. Chartmill shows 1.669B, revised down 9.39% over 3 months (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/DAO/estimates, via search snippet). TheRightTrader shows '1.7B' from 3 analysts (https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/dao), probably RMB mislabelled as USD. The two sources roughly agree but the currency is ambiguous. Q3 2025 base is RMB1,628.5m, so the bar implies about +2.5% YoY. EPS bar is $0.22 from Chartmill alone and is not reconcilable with Q2's $0.11, so it is unsourced and every profit-side size is capped small. The company gives no numeric guidance; the only guide is qualitative (H2 operating-profit breakthroughs; device GM back above 40% in H2).
positioning_check: FINRA short interest via Equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/dao/short-interest): 790,027 shares on 2026-09-30, 672,508 on 10-15 (DTC 25.2), 620,874 on 10-30 (DTC 20.8, ADV 29,855). That is about 0.5% of the 120.6m shares outstanding. The float is smaller because NetEase holds the majority. Shorts were covering into the print. Days to cover is high only because the ADS trades about 26k shares a day; by share count it is not a crowded short. Options: front-expiry chain unusable (ATM spread 117% of mid), no skew, put/call OI 0.29 on 300 contracts total, so the market makes no readable directional statement. Tape: spot 18.87, 20d +2.0%, 5d -2.7%, 8.8% below the 52w high and +124% off the 52w low, after a year-long re-rating from about $9.

findings.finding: Q3 2025 operating income was only RMB28.3m (1.7% margin, -73.7% YoY). Q2 2026 printed a record RMB111.5m (7.6% margin, gross margin 48.9% vs 43.0%), and management said on the Q2 call that it expected 'meaningful breakthroughs at the operating profit level in the second half of 2026'. Q3 operating income is therefore very likely to be a multiple of last year's. Sizing is capped because the EPS bar is unsourced ($0.22 from one source), and this lands inside what management already signalled.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Profit beats have paid little on the print day. Q2 2026: EPS $0.11 vs $0.02 with revenue -5.7% vs est, close +1.3% (16.65 to 16.86), then +8.8% the next day. Q4 2025 (2026-02-12): EPS $0.07 vs $0.04 and revenue beat, close -4.5% (9.48 to 9.05). Source: Yahoo chart bars and therighttrader table.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock has re-rated from about $9 to $19 on the profit story. If the market had fully priced a large Q3 profit step-up, the stock would not have sold off on the last three print days. With no numeric guide and an EPS bar nobody can reconcile, the size of the step-up is genuinely unknown.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base RMB28.3m from the company release (https://www.streetinsider.com/Basic+Content/Youdao+Reports+Third+Quarter+2025+Unaudited+Financial+Results/25640015.html). CEO said on the Q2 release that profitability and cash flow would improve further in H2 (https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260820/c679140086.shtml). Different documents from the same company.

findings.finding: Online marketing faces a hard comparison. Q3 2025 grew 51.1% to RMB739.7m on NetEase-group and overseas demand. In Q2 2026 the segment fell 7.7% to RMB584.4m under a 'stricter focus on higher-ROI engagements'. If Q3 falls at a similar rate (about RMB680m), the segment takes about RMB55-60m off total revenue against a bar that needs about +2.5% YoY. Revenue missed consensus in Q1 (-2.9%) and Q2 (-5.7%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: revenue miss of -5.7% with an EPS beat closed +1.3%. Q1 2026: revenue miss of -2.9% with EPS in line closed -6.9% (12.40 to 11.54). Q3 2025: ad strength but a profit collapse closed -8.1%. Revenue misses alone have not been decisive.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The revenue consensus was cut 9.39% over three months (Chartmill), so analysts have moved. If the comparison were fully reflected, the bar would sit at or below flat YoY rather than about +2.5%. Net of the rest of the company: learning services (about 50% of revenue) laps a -16.2% quarter and could offset most of this.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 segment numbers come from a different document, the Q3 2025 release (https://www.streetinsider.com/Basic+Content/Youdao+Reports+Third+Quarter+2025+Unaudited+Financial+Results/25640015.html). No NetEase Q3 marketing data yet: NetEase reports the same morning (https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20261105cn89888/netease-to-report-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-november-19).

findings.finding: Learning services laps an easy comparison. Q3 2025 was RMB643.1m (-16.2% YoY). Q2 2026 grew +20.9% to RMB795.6m on Youdao Lingshi tutoring (retention over 75%), at a 65.5% gross margin. A repeat of about +20% in the seasonally strong summer quarter gives about RMB770m, roughly +RMB130m YoY, the largest single positive revenue line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Learning growth of +20.9% in Q2 coincided with a +1.3% print-day close. No clean history of this line alone moving the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely in consensus already: the bar's about +2.5% total growth presumably assumes learning growth. It is filed because it is the offset to the marketing and device negatives, under lesson 9.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base from the Q3 2025 release (streetinsider link above). Lingshi retention from the Q2 call (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/DAO/Q22026). Shares the Q2 release with finding 2.

findings.finding: Smart devices: the industry and the company are both shrinking. RUNTO (洛图科技) data cited by 36Kr on 2026-11-02: China learning-tablet Q3 2026 units -30.8% YoY to 1.25m, revenue -17.1%, worse than H1 (-14.2% units). Youdao device revenue fell -42.6% in Q1 and -31.5% in Q2 (to RMB86.8m), with gross margin down to 32.8% on memory costs. Q3 2025 device revenue was RMB245.8m at 50.3% gross margin on a new Dictionary Pen, a hard base. Management's promised H2 device gross margin above 40% is at risk while memory costs stay elevated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Device declines in Q1 (-42.6%) and Q2 (-31.5%) came with print-day closes of -6.9% and +1.3%. The line is small, about 6-10% of revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The industry Q3 figure is recent (November) and sits in Chinese-language trade press, not the English wire. Even so, the company's own device decline is public and the segment is small. A device gross-margin miss against the stated above-40% target is the part that could surprise.
findings.independence: Industry proxy, not company data. Company device trend and the above-40% target from the Q2 call (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/DAO/Q22026). Q3 2025 base from the Q3 2025 release.

findings.finding: AI subscription sales are slowing: over RMB100m in Q1 2026 (+70%+ YoY), then about RMB100m in Q2 (+20%+ YoY). This is the AI-native narrative the re-rating rests on, and another step down in Q3 growth would weaken it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No isolated reaction history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Public in the Q2 disclosures, so mostly priced. The trend is easy to miss because the headline is 'about RMB100m' both quarters.
findings.independence: Q2 figure confirmed on the Q2 call (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/DAO/Q22026). Shares the 36Kr document with finding 4.

findings.finding: Reaction function: DAO closed lower on the print day in three of its last four releases, from the prior close to the event-day close (all bmo): Q3 2025 (2025-11-20) 9.75 to 8.96 = -8.1%; Q4 2025 (2026-02-12) 9.48 to 9.05 = -4.5% despite an EPS and revenue beat; Q1 2026 (2026-05-21) 12.40 to 11.54 = -6.9%; Q2 2026 (2026-08-20) 16.65 to 16.86 = +1.3% despite a large EPS beat. Two of those were followed by large next-day rebounds outside this window (+12.3% on 05-22, +8.8% on 08-21).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the reaction history itself: median absolute print-day move about 5.7%, three of four down.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline carries no reaction history for this name, because EDGAR 6-K dates could not be read, so the pattern is not in the sealed file. On an ADS trading about 26k shares a day, the print-day session in New York is thin and early-morning selling has not been absorbed until the next session.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 drop confirmed by the Tiger 'Youdao Stock Plummets 7.69% as Q3 Profit and Margins Decline' (https://www-web.itiger.com/news/1170468497). Q2 premarket +1.8% per RTTNews (https://www.rttnews.com/3682610/youdao-returns-to-profit-in-q2.aspx).

findings.finding: Short interest fell from 790,027 (09-30) to 620,874 (10-30) shares while days to cover stayed 20.8-25.2 on a very thin ADS (ADV about 27-30k). A profit beat meets about 21 days of short cover on a name with almost no liquidity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The +8.8% and +12.3% day-after rebounds after the last two prints are consistent with thin-liquidity covering, but both fall outside this window.
findings.why_not_priced: Small. At about 0.5% of shares outstanding this is not a crowded short by share count. It matters only because volume is tiny.

findings.finding: Financing: the Q2 release repeats going-concern language that depends on external financing, with NetEase support of a RMB878.0m short-term loan and about $118.9m of long-term loans. NetEase extended the loan maturities to 2030-03-31 in April 2026, and Q2 operating cash flow was RMB334.2m. This is support from the parent with a visible use, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The going-concern language has appeared in every recent release with no visible reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Fully priced: it is standing language. Filed for completeness; only a change in NetEase support would matter.
findings.independence: Maturity extension to 2030 reported in Q1 2026 coverage (https://tirto.id/youdao-reports-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results-hwyc).

outside_window.finding: NetEase's ANANTA, with over 17m pre-registrations, launches globally on 2027-01-15. A pre-launch marketing wave could support Youdao's NetEase-group ad revenue in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. That only matters inside this window if management cites it on the call as Q4 ad demand.

NetEase Q3 2026 release: same morning as Youdao (Nov 19 bmo), so no counterparty read-through is available before the print
Tencent Q3 2026 marketing services: not confirmed in search; only a Guoxin preview (+18%) and an unverifiable article
Gaotu Q3 2026 (edtech peer): reports 2026-11-25, after the window
Double 11 2026 Youdao device and dictionary-pen sales rankings: nothing found

baseline_tension: The baseline has no options read and no reaction history, so there is no market statement to agree or disagree with. The 124% rise off the 52-week low says the profit re-rating is already in the price, which fits the pattern of print days being sold.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar unsourced) plus 'inside what was guided': the operating-profit finding cut from +1.0 to +0.6, because the EPS bar has one unreconcilable source and the H2 profit step-up was already signalled qualitatively.
Lesson 9 (segment net of the rest): online marketing cut from -1.0 to -0.8, because learning services (about half of revenue, easy comparison) is filed as the offset.
Lesson 5 (proxy smaller): the devices finding cut from -0.8 to -0.5, because it rests on RUNTO industry data, not company data, and devices are under 10% of revenue.
Lesson 1 and core section 4: the reaction-history finding cut from -1.0 to -0.8, because the same concern also moves p_up and should not count twice.
Lesson 4 (financing): the NetEase loans kept at 0, since they fund a business with positive operating cash flow and maturities extended to 2030.

Lesson 7: short interest looked up before filing negatives; not crowded by share count (about 0.5% of outstanding), so the negatives were not shrunk for squeeze risk; the scaled numbers (abs_move 6.5, p_up 45) were not changed.
